turns.prompt_text: how do you dampen the sound of small fan makes
turns.response_html:
To dampen small fan noise, reduce vibration and absorb sound by using rubber or silicone anti-vibration mounts to isolate the fan, placing a dense mat underneath it, cleaning the blades, and checking for and tightening any loose screws.

For more advanced dampening, you can line its housing with acoustic foam or build a soundproof enclosure. You can also try lowering the fan speed if that's an option.
